title: Weight change when fixing a coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\delta<1$, and let $\rho$ be an assignment of a restriction state to each coordinate in $[n]$. If coordinate $i$ is free in $\rho$, then for either sign $s\in\{\pm1\}$, the weight of $\rho$ equals $2\delta/(1-\delta)$ times the weight obtained by fixing coordinate $i$ to $s$ and leaving every other restriction state unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $\rho$ assigns a restriction state to each coordinate
